feature.name: Chart Design
feature.what_it_does: Design a selected chart — add chart elements, quick layouts, colors, chart styles, switch row/column, edit the source data and change the chart type.
feature.affects: the design and data of the selected chart
feature.behavior: Design a selected chart — add chart elements, quick layouts, colors, chart styles, switch row/column, edit the source data and change the chart type. Group controls: subfeature:chart-add-element, subfeature:chart-change-colors, subfeature:chart-change-type, subfeature:chart-edit-data, subfeature:chart-quick-layout, subfeature:chart-style, subfeature:chart-switch-row-column

connections.why: measured: the hosting contextual tab appears only in this object's context

subfeatures.name: Add Chart Element
subfeatures.what_it_does: Adds/removes chart elements — axes, titles, data labels, gridlines, legend, trendlines (menu).
subfeatures.behavior: Opens Add Chart Element (dropdown). Contents (11 controls): Axes, Axis Titles, Chart Title, Data Labels, Data Table, Error Bars, Gridlines, Legend, Lines, Trendline, Up/Down Bars. [flyout of subfeature:chart-add-element — commands/tiles are endpoints; openers descended per the depth-endpoint rule]

subfeatures.name: Change Colors
subfeatures.what_it_does: Applies a color scheme to the chart's data series from a gallery.
subfeatures.behavior: Opens Change Colors (dropdown). Contents (14 controls): Color swatches, Change Colors, Line up, Colorful Palette 1, Colorful Palette 2, Colorful Palette 3, Colorful Palette 4, Monochromatic Palette 1, Page down, Monochromatic Palette 2, Monochromatic Palette 3, Monochromatic Palette 4, Monochromatic Palette 5, Line down. [flyout of subfeature:chart-change-colors — commands/tiles are endpoints; openers descended per the depth-endpoint rule; sections: Colorful, Monochromatic]

subfeatures.name: Change Chart Type
subfeatures.what_it_does: Opens the Change Chart Type dialog to switch the chart to a different type.
subfeatures.behavior: Opens Change Chart Type (dialog). Contents (31 controls): Recent, Templates, Column, Line, Pie, Bar, Area, X Y (Scatter), Map, Stock, Surface, Radar, Treemap, Sunburst, Histogram, Box & Whisker. [the Change Chart Type dialog; enumerated across 1 tab(s)]

subfeatures.name: Edit / Select Data
subfeatures.what_it_does: Accesses the chart's underlying worksheet data — edit data (opens the linked Excel workbook), select data range, show the data grid, and refresh.
subfeatures.behavior: Opens Edit Data (dropdown) (dropdown). Contents (2 controls): Edit Data, Edit Data in Excel. [flyout of subfeature:chart-edit-data — commands/tiles are endpoints; openers descended per the depth-endpoint rule]

subfeatures.name: Quick Layout
subfeatures.what_it_does: Applies a preset arrangement of the chart's elements from a gallery.
subfeatures.behavior: Opens Quick Layout (dropdown). Contents (13 controls): Color swatches, Quick Layout, Layout 1, Layout 2, Layout 3, Layout 4, Layout 5, Layout 6, Layout 7, Layout 8, Layout 9, Layout 10, Layout 11. [flyout of subfeature:chart-quick-layout — commands/tiles are endpoints; openers descended per the depth-endpoint rule]

subfeatures.name: Chart Styles gallery
subfeatures.what_it_does: Applies an overall visual style to the chart from the gallery.
subfeatures.behavior: Direct action: Applies an overall visual style to the chart from the gallery. Applied immediately to the chart's visual style; toggle state (where applicable) is reflected by the button's highlighted look.

subfeatures.name: Switch Row/Column
subfeatures.what_it_does: Swaps which of the source data's rows and columns map to the chart's axis vs series.
subfeatures.behavior: Direct action: Swaps which of the source data's rows and columns map to the chart's axis vs series. Applied immediately to the chart's data orientation; toggle state (where applicable) is reflected by the button's highlighted look.
